svg.text: Fast mode, one candidate at a time
Red parts change every candidate. Blue parts are computed once and reused for all of them.
Stored in the file (hidden RGB drawn)
Rows 60–63, x 48–63. The 5 dashed pixels get new hidden colours every candidate; in game they stay invisible.

g.text: Last 5 pixels: the same 15 byte values in a new order (alpha stays 00)
header, Huffman tables, compressed pixels, watermark
a0 4b b9 9a e4 df 7d 11 7d a6 19 f3
Illustrative values. The real search does this about 3.85 billion times per second on an RTX 5060 Ti.
